difficulty_reason: Density of the etale locus U'_d in U_d for the universal finite syntomic family: opens with the same-reasoning maximal-open reduction, then the henselization argument - the strict henselization A at u' splits the fibre Z amalg W with Z finite, A regular with Z etale over the generic point, and the residue field is adjusted by a flat local ring map quotiented at a minimal prime. Retained author proof at lines 2425-2479.
